effects.effect: You can extend your psionic senses beyond their usual range. Once on each of your turns, you can search for hidden creatures as a free maneuver (see Hide and Sneak in Chapter 9: [Tests](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/chapter/tests)). Additionally, once you establish line of effect to a thinking creature within [distance](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) of your [Mind Spike](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.talent.level-1/mind-spike) ability, you always have line of effect to that creature until they move beyond that [distance](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance).
